targets.expected_type: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ z : ℝ, HasDerivAt (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtExtension ε) (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtExtensionDeriv ε z) z
∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtExtension ε)

∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).1) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).2)
∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ z → 0 ≤ HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z
∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ z.1 - z.2 → (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).1 - (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).2 = (Real.sqrt (ε + (z.1 - z.2)))⁻¹
∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtSlope ε = 1 / (2 * ε ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))

∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Monotone (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).1) ∧ ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).2) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ z → 0 ≤ HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, 0 ≤ z.1 - z.2 → (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).1 - (HiddenMonotonicity.SmoothDC.inverseSqrtPair ε z).2 = (Real.sqrt (ε + (z.1 - z.2)))⁻¹)
